lede: Thursday's Planning and Zoning Commission meeting is the one to watch this week — the Town's own Carhenge Redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave is up for a Preliminary Large Scale Subdivision review and concept approval, three Town-owned projects in the Accommodations 2 zone all on the same agenda. Also on Thursday, SMART's board votes on two vendor contracts central to the gondola structural analysis work, which is about as close to a bridge-or-bust decision as this valley gets right now.

notable.stake: Town votes on Carhenge lot consolidation and three Accommodations 2 zone projects.
SMART votes on two gondola structural-analysis contracts — key step for gondola's future.
